title: SourceArchiveService
responsibility: Archives committed implementation and associated test files as deduplicated private media, with explicit gaps.

inputs.name: SourceArchiveService.constructor.root
inputs.description: Git repository containing the selected immutable commit.

inputs.name: SourceArchiveService.constructor.out
inputs.description: History output directory; existing protected media carries source text.

inputs.name: SourceArchiveService.archive.commit
inputs.description: Selected Git commit, never a working tree or latest-ref fallback.

inputs.name: SourceArchiveService.archive.units
inputs.description: Registry units to enrich; inactive units archive no source.

inputs.name: SourceArchiveService.archive.side
inputs.description: Selected revision graph and authored scenarios for direct test imports and declared test coverage; absent historical graphs provide no inferred tests.

outputs.name: SourceArchiveService.archive
outputs.description: Adds sourceFiles and revision-bound testFiles to units. Owned folders expand to tracked files; unreadable contents retain explicit gaps. Never reads working-copy files.
